notes.title: Update 7.8.0. New Stuff
notes.content:
[p]JANE KEYES: grace in a skirt, fire in her eyes[/p][p]Meet the NEW HEROINE — fierce yet graceful Jane.[/p][p]A seductive vixen who broke the hearts of many daring men. Her star began to rise within the walls of a rowdy saloon, where danger lurked for every girl at every table. But for Jane, it became the perfect cover.[/p][p]No lock can stop this trickster, no server can withstand her. And like any true mercenary, she always has an ace hidden up her sleeve.[/p][p]Her talents are remarkable: she can easily cause trouble for her enemies by dealing AoE damage and creating explosive portals that leave behind hazardous fire puddles. What’s more, she can lift debuffs from herself and get immunity to them while using her active abilities.[/p][p]
Unique Weapons’ NEW PERK[/p][p]Stronger, more dangerous, and battles even more thrilling![/p][p]Just as a single shot can change the course of a fight, the unique weapons’ NEW PERK can turn the tide of your battle.[/p][p]One hit — and the shockwave deals instant AoE damage. After that, all opponents caught in the blast become especially vulnerable: they won’t be able to use their active abilities, and the damage they take from your active abilities or your ally’s will increase![/p][p]A truly valuable aide in every battle![/p]

notes.title: Left To Survive is available on Steam NOW!
notes.content:
[b]The post-apocalyptic world of Left To Survive is coming to Steam![/b]

Life is no longer what it used to be. The world is teeming with the undead. No place to run or hide. Become a hero of this zombie-apocalypse reality.
- join tournaments
- collect an arsenal
- get valuable gear
- build a base – a new home for many survivors
- start expeditions to meet the heroes
- challenge other players in PvP matches and helicopter raids

Play [b]Left To Survive[/b].
Save humanity!
